text:
This was my first time using their services. I contacted them via their Facebook page chat, made an appointment, and the clinic asked me to register and confirm my reservation. They also mentioned that I could come to the clinic if I wasn't able to have the procedure done online. Since I'd never done this before, there might have been a mistake in the online booking process. I thought I could just come to the clinic. However, when I walked in, the assistant seemed confused, so I explained everything to them and filled out the required information. The blonde assistant at the counter didn't provide good service, judging by her demeanor and facial expression. I would like to commend the other assistant with long hair and glasses; she provided excellent service and spoke politely. The doctor was also very polite. However, the assistant doing the eyelash extensions didn't use polite language when calling the patient's name before they entered the room, and her expression seemed unwilling to help. I understand their workload, and it was close to closing time, but I still went to my appointment at 7:00 PM. I want to emphasize that I paid for these services; I wasn't getting them for free. My government health insurance wasn't valid that day, and I plan to get braces at this clinic, but my first experience here was already disappointing.
📍Update📌 The clinic has since contacted me and apologized. They haven't ignored my complaint. Aside from the service of some staff members, overall this place is very good. The doctor did a great job and was very gentle. Thank you very much! 🙏
